# Draft:Stewart Milne Group

Stewart Milne Group Limited was a Scottish housebuilding company based in Westhill, Aberdeenshire.
History
The company was founded in Aberdeen as Stewart Milne Construction Ltd in 1975 by Stewart Milne, an electrician who had worked since 1972 as a sole trader specialising in the renovation of bathrooms.
2020–present: COVID-19 pandemic, attempted sale, and collapse
In October 2021, Stewart Milne announced a sale of its timber frame production operations – they were acquired by James Donaldson & Sons (later Donaldson Group) in December of that year.
In April 2022, Stewart Milne Group announced that it was seeking a buyer, with Milne additionally stating that he planned to retire. The sale was withdrawn in December of that year, with the company citing economic circumstances, including elevated inflation and interest rates associated with the September 2022 mini-budget. The sale was re-advertised in July 2023 following an improvement in earnings before taxes for the company.
The company went into administration on 8 January 2024, with Teneo appointed as the insolvency practitioner and 217 employees made redundant.
